title: Loh Kah Meng — AI Systems for Human Decision-Making
excerpt: AI-powered decision support systems in healthcare, workforce analytics, credit risk, and customer retention — built around the idea that AI should make people better decision-makers, not replace them.
content_html:
Decision Support Systems · AI & Data Science

AI that makes people better decision-makers — not AI that decides for them.

I build systems that sit next to human judgment, not in front of it: transparent models, honest uncertainty, and interfaces that explain themselves. At the center is a mission — augmenting the people who care for patients — with the same principle proven across workforce, credit, aerospace, and customer-retention decisions.

Philosophy

On Human–AI Relationship

Every project on this site is built on the same working belief: the goal of applied AI is not to replace a person's judgment but to make that judgment sharper, faster, and better informed. A model that quietly makes the call is a liability. A model that shows its reasoning, flags what it doesn't know, and hands a clear decision back to a human — that's a tool worth trusting.

01

Augment, don't replace

Systems are designed as decision support — surfacing patterns, risks, and probabilities for a human to weigh, rather than issuing verdicts a person is expected to accept on faith.

02

Transparency over accuracy theater

A model's headline metric is never the whole story. Every project here documents what the data can't tell you — missingness, top-coding, sampling bias — alongside what the model gets right.

03

Built for the person who has to act

A dashboard nobody reads and a model nobody trusts are the same failure. Every system is designed around the actual decision-maker: what they need to see, in language they already use.

The Pento‑Helix

Underneath those three principles sits a broader frame I work from: the Pento‑Helix. Pento, for five — a structure meant to stay portable, flexible, and adaptable across contexts, not fixed to one project. Helix, because it behaves like DNA: one constant structure that expresses itself differently everywhere it's deployed, the way RNA carries out what DNA encodes.

01Human–AI collaboration and synchronization

02Human–AI harmony

03Each side strengthening the other's skills and expertise, while understanding the other's limitations — mutual respect

04Shared social responsibility for what gets built

05Progressive, together — the constant thread across every project, and what this site's mark is built around: a dot held steady at the center — the Tao — with a spiral of motion, a Milky Way, turning around it.

The first four pillars above are how the Pento‑Helix takes shape in the Human–AI Augment Systems work collected on this site. Other projects will express their own version of the same four; the fifth never changes.

Selected Work

Nine decision-support systems, grouped by the human problem they solve

Every system here rests on one belief: AI should make people better decision-makers, not replace them. That belief has a home — the Nurse Augmenting System, human-centered patient care and the core of the AEGIS programme. The rest prove the same principle holds across domains: two are deployed as live, working apps, and all carry honest, full write-ups of what each model can and can't tell you.

NEW SERIES · NOW LIVE

Diagnostic Augmenting Systems

A new series of screening tools grounded in the physiological kinetics of the disease itself — each returns an interpretable three-class risk stratification, surfaces its own uncertainty as a confidence score, and flags the at-risk patient while a clinician stays in command. First release: DRAS, diabetes risk from a 2-hour OGTT.

🌍 Plans across 24 countries worldwide Kinetics-grounded Human-in-command

Domain 01 · Biomedical Intelligence

Biomedical Intelligence

Predicting a patient’s risk so a clinician can act early — AI that augments the nurse, never replaces her.

Domain 02 · Pre-Emptive Maintenance

Pre-Emptive Maintenance

Read the life that’s left in a machine, and service it before it fails.

Research · Full Case Study · Prognostics

Turbofan Remaining Useful Life — Pre-emptive Maintenance

An eight-regressor remaining-useful-life benchmark on NASA's C-MAPSS turbofan data, run separately across all four degradation regimes (FD001–FD004) and ranked by RMSE and the NASA asymmetric prognostics score — late predictions punished harder than early ones, because for a jet engine a late call is the dangerous one. An interactive engine ages green → amber → red in real time, so "schedule maintenance before failure" is something you see, not just read.

AI-Powered Predictive Maintenance Decision Support System

An eight-model benchmark on the AI4I 2020 dataset (10,000 machines, a 3.4% failure rate), run across two controlled experiments — where two engineered features lifted every model and decided the champion. The five built-in failure-mode flags were removed first to prevent target leakage, and the operating threshold was tuned for advance warning, not headline accuracy. A Flask app puts the model behind a technician-facing form with a red / amber / green verdict.

Domain 03 · Orbital & Space Safety

Orbital & Space Safety

An advance-warning signal for satellite-collision risk — a small voice in a very large ocean.

Featured · Full Case Study · Deployed

AEGIS Orbital Watch: Advance-Warning System for Satellite Collision Risk

Built on ESA's Kelvins Collision Avoidance dataset (13,154 events) — an eight-model benchmark across four increasingly rigorous passes, culminating in a deployed, human-in-the-loop app that scores live conjunction data and lets an operator record their own call alongside the model's. Built to raise awareness of a growing orbital problem.

Domain 04 · Decision Intelligence

Decision Intelligence

Weighing risk to make a fair, transparent call — in lending, retention, and livelihoods.

Featured · Full Case Study · Deployed

Employee Attrition Target List — Retention Decision Support

An eight-model attrition benchmark on IBM's HR data (1,470 employees, 16.1% attrition) — served as an anonymised, score-free retention target list. The champion isn't the highest-accuracy model; it's Logistic Regression, chosen for recall (68% of real leavers caught) and interpretability, because a retention list that misses the leavers has missed the point. Overtime — the strongest driver, ~3× the attrition rate — is a live toggle.

AI-Powered Workforce Income Analytics & Decision Support System

A unified master dataset (48,790 U.S. Census records) feeding a Power BI analytics layer and a reusable AI framework that benchmarked five ML algorithms across two feature-engineering experiments — closed once the champion model reached the published literature ceiling for this benchmark.

Finance

AI-Powered Loan Default Risk Decision Support System

A 12-model benchmark on 29.9 million LendingClub records — where an obvious leak was caught and removed, and a suspiciously perfect score that remained was investigated and explained rather than just reported.

Marketing

AI-Powered Marketing Decision Support System for Customer Retention

Nine models were benchmarked on IBM's Telco Churn dataset — and the highest-accuracy one wasn't picked. The production model was chosen for matching a real business threshold instead.

content_html_zh:
决策支持系统·人工智能与数据科学

人工智能让人们成为更好的决策者，而不是为他们做决定的人工智能。

我构建的系统位于人类判断旁边，而不是位于其前面：透明的模型、诚实的不确定性以及能够自我解释的界面。 其核心是一项使命——增强护理患者的能力——这一原则在劳动力、信贷、航空航天和客户保留决策中得到了证明。

哲学

论人与人工智能的关系

该网站上的每个项目都建立在相同的工作信念之上：应用人工智能的目标不是取代人的判断，而是使判断更敏锐、更快、更明智。 一个默默地做出决定的模型是一种负担。 一个模型可以显示其推理，标记其不知道的内容，并将明确的决策交还给人类——这是一个值得信赖的工具。

01

增强，而非取代

系统被设计为决策支持——呈现模式、风险和概率供人类权衡，而不是发布人们应该相信的结论。

02

透明度高于准确性剧院

模型的标题指标从来都不是故事的全部。 这里的每个项目都记录了数据无法告诉您的内容——缺失、顶级编码、抽样偏差——以及模型正确的内容。

03

为必须采取行动的人而打造

没有人阅读的仪表板和没有人信任的模型是同样的失败。 每个系统都是围绕实际决策者设计的：他们需要看到什么，用他们已经使用的语言。

五螺旋

在这三个原则的下面是我工作的一个更广泛的框架：五螺旋。 Pento，五个人——一种旨在保持便携、灵活和跨环境适应性的结构，而不是固定于一个项目。 螺旋，因为它的行为类似于 DNA：一种恒定的结构，在其部署的任何地方都以不同的方式表达自己，就像 RNA 执行 DNA 编码的方式一样。

03双方加强对方的技能和专业知识，同时了解对方的局限性——相互尊重

04共同承担所建项目的社会责任

05进步、共同——贯穿每个项目的恒定线索，以及这个网站的标志是围绕什么建立的：一个稳定在中心的点——道——带有螺旋运动，一条银河系，围绕着它旋转。

上面的前四个支柱是五螺旋如何在本网站收集的人类-人工智能增强系统工作中形成的。 其他项目将表达相同四个的自己的版本；第五个永远不会改变。

作品选

九个决策支持系统，按其解决的人类问题分组

这里的每个系统都基于一个信念：人工智能应该让人们成为更好的决策者，而不是取代他们。 这种信念有其根源——护士增强系统、以人为本的患者护理和 AEGIS 计划的核心。 其余的证明了相同的原则适用于跨领域：两个被部署为实时、可工作的应用程序，并且所有应用程序都诚实、完整地记录了每个模型可以告诉你和不能告诉你的内容。

研究 · 完整案例研究 · 预测

涡轮风扇发动机剩余使用寿命——预防性维护

基于 NASA C-MAPSS 涡轮风扇数据的八回归量剩余使用寿命基准，在所有四种退化状态 (FD001-FD004) 上单独运行，并根据 RMSE 和 NASA 不对称预测评分进行排名 - 迟到的预测比早期的预测受到更严重的惩罚，因为对于喷气发动机来说，迟到的预测是危险的。 交互式引擎实时老化为绿色 → 琥珀色 → 红色，因此“在故障发生前安排维护”是您可以看到的内容，而不仅仅是读到的内容。
